The '''Dalisor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Yushan sector/Legends|Yushan sector]], a part of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] regions. It lay on the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]], which connected it to the [[Kaal system/Legends|Kaal]] and [[Jiroch system/Legends|Jiroch systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Dalisor system shared its name with the [[Dalisor Merchant Fleet]]<ref name="GG12">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref> and the [[291st Legion/Legends|291st Legion Dalisor]].<ref name="TEGtWF">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Dalisor system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square K-17.<ref name="TEA" />
